card.name: Linking words before injection-site problems
card.fires_on: The word "of" (sometimes "cause" or "and") right before a named adverse event, mainly in injection and infusion warnings, as in "signs of", "risk of" and "incidence of".

modes.label: Of after risk or signs
modes.description: "of" after nouns such as risk, signs, symptoms or incidence, just before an adverse event term.

modes.label: Other links before harm terms
modes.description: A verb or "and" that leads into tissue damage or vein problems.
modes.example: as the resulting vasoconstriction may<< cause>> tissue necrosis.
